name: list_reminders
description: List reminders by status. ALWAYS use this tool for ANY reminder-related query, including: 'when is my next reminder?', 'what reminders do I have?', 'do I have any reminders?', 'show my reminders', 'check reminders', 'any upcoming reminders?', 'did I miss any reminders?', 'any pending reminders?', 'list reminders', etc. NEVER answer reminder questions from memory or context - always call this tool to get current state. Highlights 'triggered' reminders as 'missed' (already fired but not acknowledged). Returns reminders with relative time (e.g., 'in 2 hours', '30 minutes ago'). Status options: 'scheduled' (upcoming), 'triggered' (missed/unacknowledged), 'acknowledged' (completed), or 'all' (default shows all with emphasis on missed).

limit.description: Maximum number of reminders to return (default 10)
